feeds.title: Alabama Political Reporter
feeds.description: Alabama Political Reporter is a political news site devoted to Alabama politics providing accurate, reliable coverage of policy, elections, and government. It is a political news organization that gives citizens, lawmakers, business leaders, and organizations one place where they can find thorough coverage of all the political news.

feeds.title: Yellowhammer
feeds.description: Yellowhammer News is a conservative news site covering politics and culture in the state of Alabama. If you are looking for the latest news on state politics, faith, and culture, you'll find it on Yellowhammer News. Yellowhammer News is Alabama's preeminent outlet for news, analysis, and much more. They are committed to delivering the news in a manner that reflects the state of Alabama, its people, and their values.

feeds.title: Alabama Daily News
feeds.description: Alabama Daily News is the first-click destination for political news and analysis for Alabama politicians, policymakers, and those who influence them.

feeds.title: Steve Flowers
feeds.description: Inside the Statehouse with Steve Flowers covers the state political scene each week in an entertaining and informative fashion. Author Steve has been an up close participant and observer of the Alabama political scene for more than 50 years and is generally considered the ultimate authority on Alabama politics and Alabama political history.

feeds.title: Bama Politics
feeds.description: Bama Politics is a complete portal for Alabama politics, including news, legislation, and profiles of each elected official in the state of Alabama. Stay updated with Alabama political news, legislative updates, and information database of elected officials and candidates.

feeds.title: Alabama Election Protection Network Blog
feeds.description: The Alabama Election Protection Network provides Alabamians with comprehensive information and assistance at all stages of voting, from registration to absentee and early voting, to casting a vote at the polls, to overcoming obstacles to participation.
